Deviation fixture: the ZET general strike of 28 to 29 September 2026. Never a normal-behaviour replay, tuning or fixture day.

# ZET GTFS-RT frame sample, 2026-09-28, 03:00–04:30 Zagreb

**Test fixture only.** These 499 files are a fixture of this repository's tests and nothing else: the Worker never serves them (its static assets are `app/dist`, built from `app/`), no client downloads them and no page links to them. They let the tests named under "What it is for" replay real frames on any machine without the full recordings (hundreds of megabytes a day), which are never committed.

Generated by `scripts/frames-sample.mjs`; edit the script, not this file. Use `--readme-only <fixture-dir>` to refresh this file without changing the frames.

## Source and licence

ZET GTFS-Realtime (https://www.zet.hr/gtfs-rt-protobuf), the `zet-rt` source of `docs/izvori.md`, recorded frame by frame by the twin (`worker/twin/record.ts`) into R2 and pulled with the wrangler loop in `scripts/replay-twin.mjs`. ZET publishes it under the Croatian Open Licence (Otvorena dozvola) and marks the feed "SAMO ZA POTREBE TESTIRANJA". Attribution, verbatim:

> Public dataset by ZET provided under Open license, dataset source http://www.zet.hr/odredbe/datoteke-u-gtfs-formatu/669

## Artefact it belongs to

The frames name trips of a feed other than the committed artefacts' **000395**: only 80 of 951 tram reports with a trip id (8.412 %) and 3 of 6 distinct tram trip ids are found in `app/public/data/zet-trips.json` (feed 000395). Service prefixes of the tram trip ids: 0_25, 0_30. The network artefact of the committed feed is `app/public/data/zet-network.json`, graphHash `7ad4834435980e22`.

If the artefacts are rebuilt from a newer GTFS feed, the trip ids stop joining; what that means for this sample is said under "What it is for".

## How it was cut

```
node scripts/frames-sample.mjs <recordings>/2026/09/28 --from 010000 --to 023000 --out test/fixtures/frames/2026-09-28-0100-0230-start --all-modes
```

`<recordings>` is a local copy of R2's `zet-rt/` prefix. The script refuses an `--out` under any `recordings/` directory, because `.gitignore` ignores `recordings/` at any depth. The cut also passed `--lead` and `--use` with the text of this file's first line and "What it is for" paragraph.

## What it is for

Written for U2 acceptance A4 (`test/accept/service-state.test.ts`, added by U2): the strike's official start at 03:30 Zagreb on Monday 28 September, 03:00 to 04:30 Zagreb at full cadence. No vehicle has a position from 03:05:47 to 03:32:08 Zagreb, the header then pauses for 420 s, and from 03:39 four vehicles report (trams 4, 6 and 14, bus 268), where on Monday 21 September fresh positions (vehicles with a position at most 180 s old and not ahead of the header, every 30th frame) rose from 11 to 190 over the same ninety minutes; no CANCELED trip and no Alert in any frame. The service state must read `silent` by 03:50 Zagreb and not change after. The trips are of the timetable ZET switched to that day: service 0_30 of feed 000396 (feed 000395 joins 80 of 951 tram reports). The strike cannot be recorded again: never re-cut this window from another day, and keep the artefacts of its feed with the tests that replay it.
